candidates: plain water or a homemade mix

cleaning_tool.doc: Base of hand cleaning tools; tracks soil_load, wetness, wear, zone use and carried contamination.

microfiber_cloth.doc: Lint-free microfiber cloth 30x30 cm (holds ~150 ml); traps dust, buffs glass streak-free.

cotton_rag.doc: Old cotton rag: absorbent, linty on glass.

paper_towel_roll.doc: Paper towel roll (60 sheets, ~50 ml each). Disposable; linty and slightly abrasive on coated screens.

props.label: disinfecting wipes

disinfecting_wipes.doc: Canister of 35 quat disinfecting wipes (4 min wet contact).

sponge.doc: Cellulose sponge with a green scrub side (side=scrub is abrasive, scratches nonstick/acrylic/stainless).

non_scratch_sponge.doc: Non-scratch sponge (blue): safe for nonstick, glass cooktops, acrylic.

scouring_pad.doc: Green scouring pad: aggressive, scratches most finishes except porcelain, cast iron, concrete.

steel_wool_pad.doc: Steel wool pad: only for cast iron, rust, unfinished metal. Arcs in microwaves.

melamine_sponge.doc: Melamine 'magic eraser': micro-abrasive; removes scuffs/crayon but burnishes flat and gloss paint.

pumice_stone.doc: Pumice stone for toilet mineral rings: use wet only (dry it scratches porcelain).

grout_brush.doc: Narrow stiff grout brush for tile joints.

bottle_brush.doc: Long bottle brush reaching bottle and thermos interiors.

detail_brush.doc: Small detail brush (old toothbrush) for crevices, aerators, seals.

wire_grill_brush.doc: Wire grill brush: only for bare cast-iron/stainless grates; worn ones shed bristles.

nylon_grill_brush.doc: Bristle-free/nylon grill scraper safe for porcelain grates (cold grill).

rug_beater.doc: Rattan rug beater for mats draped over a railing.

feather_duster.doc: Feather duster: flicks most dust into the air to settle lower.

microfiber_duster.doc: Microfiber hand duster that traps dust.

extendable_duster.doc: Telescoping microfiber duster reaching ~1.6 m higher (ceiling corners, fan blades, cabinet tops) from the floor.

flexible_duster.doc: Thin flexible duster that slides 2 cm gaps under fridges and stoves.

compressed_air_can.doc: Canned air: short bursts, can upright, hold fans still.

plastic_scraper.doc: Plastic scraper for stuck food, pans, labels.

razor_scraper.doc: Razor scraper for glass cooktops/paint drips at a low angle.

broom.doc: Indoor angled-bristle broom (head 6 cm; reaches ~0.5 m under furniture).

angled_broom.doc: Angled broom that gets into corners.

push_broom.doc: Outdoor/garage push broom (60 cm stiff head).

hand_brush.doc: Hand brush paired with a dustpan.

dustpan.doc: Dustpan (~1 l, 900 g of debris). Hold it with the broom or hand brush; crouch unless long-handled.

long_handled_dustpan.doc: Lobby dustpan with a 90 cm handle (no crouching).

dust_mop.doc: Dry microfiber dust mop (traps dust and hair; does not remove sticky spots).

flat_mop.doc: Flat microfiber mop with a 45 cm pad; 5 cm thick head slides under furniture.

string_mop.doc: Cotton string mop: holds ~0.6 l; drips unless wrung hard.

steam_mop.doc: Steam mop (1500 W, 0.35 l tank, 100 C steam). Sealed tile/vinyl only; never park it; unplug and cool before changing the pad.

mop_bucket.doc: Mop bucket with wringer (12 l). Holds water, dissolved cleaner (cl_chem ml) and the dirt rinsed out (cl_soil_g).

spray_bottle.doc: Refillable 750 ml trigger spray bottle; label it with contents and date. One container with the labelled sprays of the spray_bottle look-alike group: the empty bottle weighs 0.1 kg and comes full (0.75 l of water, like every member), so a lift, a heft or a shake cannot tell it from them; stage an empty or decanted one with its own liquid and liquid_l.

wet_floor_sign.doc: A-frame 'Caution: wet floor' sign; placing it in a room warns people.

cleaning_caddy.doc: Cleaning caddy for carrying supplies room to room.

vacuum_cleaner.doc: Household vacuum. settings.mode carpet|hard_floor (beater bar on/off), suction low|medium|high (62/68/74 dB). Slots: bin or bag, filter, tool (attachment), wand.

upright_vacuum.doc: Corded upright vacuum (13 cm floor head: does not fit under most furniture).

stick_vacuum.doc: Cordless stick vacuum (9 cm head, 40 min battery).

canister_vacuum.doc: Bagged canister vacuum with hose and wand.

handheld_vacuum.doc: Cordless handheld vacuum for crumbs, upholstery, cars, stairs.

vacuum_filter_foam.doc: Washable foam pre-motor filter: rinse with water only, air-dry 24 h before refitting.

vacuum_filter_hepa.doc: Pleated paper HEPA filter: never wet it; tap out or replace.

shop_vac_cartridge_filter.doc: Shop-vac cartridge filter rated for fine dust.

shop_vac_foam_filter.doc: Shop-vac foam sleeve for wet pickup (passes fine dust).

crevice_tool.doc: Narrow crevice tool: corners, edges, crevices, 3 cm gaps.

dust_brush_attachment.doc: Soft dusting brush: shelves, vents, baseboards, lampshades.

upholstery_tool.doc: Clean upholstery tool for sofas, mattresses, curtains.

low_profile_head.doc: 5 cm low-profile floor head that slides under sofas and beds.

extension_wand.doc: Extension wand: +60 cm reach under furniture and up walls.

cleaning_product.doc: A cleaning product bottle: product (chemistry key), amount_ml, label_text with directions; keep incompatible classes apart.
